Ircon International Wins Rs 862 Crore Railway Contract

Ircon International's shares rose by 7% after the company announced it had secured an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contract valued at Rs 862.46 crore from East Central Railway. The contract is for track-related works, including laying and linking railway tracks and supplying materials for the third and fourth lines under the Son Nagar-Andal project.
